title: Interaction and national data on the European system 1945-1980 (INDES )
authors: Faber, J., Groenink, R., Universiteit van Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Europa Instituut (primary investigator)
descriptions: Studying interaction of political and economical processes within and between countries and their influence on international relations since world war II. National file: demographic data / economic data: production / capital formation / imports / exports / expenditures / revenues / consumption / transportation / telecommunication / military personnel and equipment / international file: exports / cooperative actions / conflict actions / distance. Background variables: residence
